Apni hikmat-o-tadabbur mein wahdahu la shareek ٭٭ Is ke nazil hone ki wajah pehle bayan ho chuki hai, Hazrat Ikrimah (Rahimahullah / R.H) farmate hain ke Yahood kehte the hum Hazrat Uzair ko poojte hain jo Allah ke bete hain aur Nasrani kehte the hum Hazrat Maseeh ko poojte hain jo Allah ke bete hain aur Majoosi kehte the hum sooraj chand ki parastish karte hain aur mushrik kehte the hum but-parast hain toh Allah Ta'ala ne yeh surah utari ke ae Nabi tum keh do ke hamara mabood toh Allah Ta'ala hai jo wahid aur ahad hai jis jaisa koi nahin jis ka koi wazeer nahin jis ka koi shareek nahin jis ka koi hamsar nahin jis ka koi ham-jins nahin jis ka barabar aur koi nahin jis ke siwa kisi mein ulohiyat nahin. Is lafz ka itlaq sirf usi ki zaat-e-paak par hota hai woh apni sifaton mein aur apne hikmat bhare kaamon mein yakta aur be-nazeer hota hai. Woh Samad hai yaani saari makhlooq us ki muhtaj hai aur woh sab se be-niyaaz hai. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (Razi Allahu Anhuma / R.A) se marwi hai ke Samad woh hai jo apni sardari mein, apni sharafat mein, apni bandagi aur azmat mein, apne ilm-o-hilm mein, apni hikmat-o-tadabbur mein sab se barha hua hai. Yeh sifatein sirf Allah Ta'ala Jalla Shaanuhu mein hi paayi jaati hain. Is ka hamsar aur is jaisa koi aur nahin woh Allah Subhanahu wa Ta'ala sab par ghalib hai aur apni zaat-o-sifat mein yakta aur be-nazeer hai, Samad ke yeh maani bhi kiye gaye hain ke jo tamam makhlooq ke fana ho jaane ke baad bhi baaqi rahe, jo hamesha ki baqa wala sab ki hifazat karne wala ho jis ki zaat la-zawal aur ghair fani ho. Hazrat Ikrimah farmate hain Samad woh hai jo na kuch khaaye na us mein se kuch nikle. Yeh maani bhi bayan kiye gaye hain ke Samad ki tafseer is ke baad hai yaani na us mein se kuch nikle na woh kisi mein se nikle yaani na us ki aulaad ho na maa baap, yeh tafseer bahut achhi aur umdah hai aur Ibn Jarir ki riwayat se Hazrat Ubayy bin Ka'b se sarahatan yeh marwi hai jaise ke pehle guzra aur bahut se Sahaba aur Tabi'een se marwi hai ke Samad kehte hain thoos cheez ko jo khokhli na ho jis ka pet na ho. Sha'bi kehte hain jo na khaata ho na peeta ho, Abdullah bin Buraidah farmate hain Samad woh noor hai jo roshan ho aur chamak damak wala ho, ek marfoo hadith mein bhi hai ke Samad woh hai jis ka pet na ho, lekin is ka marfoo hona theek nahin, sahih yeh hai ke yeh mawqoof hai. Hafiz Abu al-Qasim Tabarani (Rahimahullah / R.H) apni kitab "Al-Sunnah" mein lafz-e-Samad ki tafseer mein in tamam aqwal waghairah ko waarid kar ke likhte hain ke dar-asl yeh sab sach-che hain aur sahih hain. Kul sifatein hamare Rabb Azza wa Jalla mein hain us ki taraf sab muhtaj bhi hain woh sab se barh kar sardar aur sab se bada hai usay na pet hai na woh khokhla hai na woh khaaye na piye sab fani hai aur woh baaqi hai waghairah. Phir farmaya us ki aulaad nahin na us ke maa baap hain na biwi.

Jaise aur jagah hai yaani woh zameen-o-aasman ka paida karne wala hai usey aulaad kaise hogi? Is ki biwi nahin har cheez ko usi ne paida kiya hai: yaani woh har cheez ka khaliq maalik hai phir us ki makhlooq aur milkiyat mein se us ki barabari aur hamsari karne wala kaun hoga? Woh in tamam uyoob aur nuqsaan se paak hai jaise aur jagah farmaya (وَقَالُوا اتَّخَذَ الرَّحْمٰنُ وَلَدًا al-kh), yaani yeh kuffar kehte hain ke Allah ki aulaad hai tum to ek bari buri cheez laaye qareeb hai ke aasman phat jayein aur zameen shaq ho jaye aur pahar para para ho kar gir parein, is bina par ke unhon ne kaha ke Allah ki aulaad hai halanke Allah ko yeh laaiq hi nahin ke us ki aulaad ho tamam zameen-o-aasman mein ke kul ke kul Allah ke ghulaam hi ban kar aane wale hain Allah ke paas tamam ka shumaar hai aur unhein ek ek kar ke gin rakha hai aur yeh sab ke sab tanha tanha us ke paas Qayamat ke din hazir hone wale hain aur jagah hai (وَقَالُوا اتَّخَذَ الرَّحْمٰنُ وَلَدًا سُبْحَانَهُ بَلْ عِبَادٌ مُّكْرَمُونَ 26) (21. Al-Anbiya: 26), yaani in kafiron ne kaha ke Rahman ki aulaad hai Allah is se paak hai balkeh woh to Allah ke ba-izzat bande hain baat mein bhi us se sabqat nahin karte usi ke farmaan par aamil hain aur jagah hai (وَجَعَلُوا بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ الْجِنَّةِ نَسَبًا al-kh), yaani unhon ne Allah Ta'ala ke aur jinnat ke darmiyan nasab qaaim kar rakha hai halanke jinnat to khud us ki farmanbardari mein hazir hain Allah Ta'ala un ke bayan karda uyoob se paak-o-bartar hai. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke eeza dene wali baaton ko sunte hue sabr karne mein Allah se ziyada saabir koi nahin log us ki aulaad batate hain aur phir bhi woh unhein roziyan deta hai aur aafiyat-o-tang dasti ata farmata hai. Bukhari ki aur riwayat mein hai ke Allah Ta'ala farmata hai Ibn-e-Aadam mujhe jhutlata hai halanke usey aisa na chahiye mujhe gaaliyan deta hai aur usey yeh bhi laaiq na tha us ka mujhe jhutlana to yeh hai ke woh kehta hai jis tarah awwalan Allah ne mujhe paida kiya aise hi phir nahin lautaye ga halanke pehli martaba ki paidaish doosri martaba ki paidaish se kuch aasaan to na thi jab main is par qadir hoon to us par kyun nahin? Aur us ka mujhe gaaliyan dena yeh hai ke woh kehta hai Allah ki aulaad hai halanke main tanha hoon main ek hi hoon main Samad hoon na meri aulaad na mere maa baap na mujh jaisa koi. Aur Alhamdulillah Surah Ikhlas ki tafseer Allah ke fazl-o-karam aur us ke lutf-o-rahm se khatam hui.

Woh in tamam uyoob aur nuqsaan se paak hai jaise aur jagah farmaya (وَقَالُوا اتَّخَذَ الرَّحْمٰنُ وَلَدًا al-kh), yaani yeh kuffar kehte hain ke Allah ki aulaad hai tum to ek bari buri cheez laaye qareeb hai ke aasman phat jayein aur zameen shaq ho jaye aur pahar para para ho kar gir parein, is bina par ke unhon ne kaha ke Allah ki aulaad hai halanke Allah ko yeh laaiq hi nahin ke us ki aulaad ho tamam zameen-o-aasman mein ke kul ke kul Allah ke ghulaam hi ban kar aane wale hain Allah ke paas tamam ka shumaar hai aur unhein ek ek kar ke gin rakha hai aur yeh sab ke sab tanha tanha us ke paas Qayamat ke din hazir hone wale hain aur jagah hai (وَقَالُوا اتَّخَذَ الرَّحْمٰنُ وَلَدًا سُبْحَانَهُ بَلْ عِبَادٌ مُّكْرَمُونَ 26) (21. Al-Anbiya: 26), yaani in kafiron ne kaha ke Rahman ki aulaad hai Allah is se paak hai balkeh woh to Allah ke ba-izzat bande hain baat mein bhi us se sabqat nahin karte usi ke farmaan par aamil hain aur jagah hai (وَجَعَلُوا بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ الْجِنَّةِ نَسَبًا al-kh), yaani unhon ne Allah Ta'ala ke aur jinnat ke darmiyan nasab qaaim kar rakha hai halanke jinnat to khud us ki farmanbardari mein hazir hain Allah Ta'ala un ke bayan karda uyoob se paak-o-bartar hai. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke eeza dene wali baaton ko sunte hue sabr karne mein Allah se ziyada saabir koi nahin log us ki aulaad batate hain aur phir bhi woh unhein roziyan deta hai aur aafiyat-o-tang dasti ata farmata hai. Bukhari ki aur riwayat mein hai ke Allah Ta'ala farmata hai Ibn-e-Aadam mujhe jhutlata hai halanke usey aisa na chahiye mujhe gaaliyan deta hai aur usey yeh bhi laaiq na tha us ka mujhe jhutlana to yeh hai ke woh kehta hai jis tarah awwalan Allah ne mujhe paida kiya aise hi phir nahin lautaye ga halanke pehli martaba ki paidaish doosri martaba ki paidaish se kuch aasaan to na thi jab main is par qadir hoon to us par kyun nahin? Aur us ka mujhe gaaliyan dena yeh hai ke woh kehta hai Allah ki aulaad hai halanke main tanha hoon main ek hi hoon main Samad hoon na meri aulaad na mere maa baap na mujh jaisa koi. Aur Alhamdulillah Surah Ikhlas ki tafseer Allah ke fazl-o-karam aur us ke lutf-o-rahm se khatam hui.
